what: After the port a read of an input or tracked field is named by its struct alone (Crate, CrateResolution) with ReadKind::InputField(n)/TrackedField(n); salsa named each field (data, cfg_options, extra_data, workspace_data, modules). blaze-item-hash reads.rs RULES rules by field (Crate.data and cfg_options are CrateInput, CrateResolution.modules is refused), so round 8 classify::every_read_of_the_steps... refuses (Infer, Crate), (Mir, Crate), (Mir, CrateResolution) unlisted. Please record each field name in the vtable (the macros have the idents) and give Storage a field_name(ingredient, field) -> &'static str, so blaze-item-hash can name a field read `Crate.data` without a hand table of field numbers that would drift.

history.note: Vtable.fields + Input::FIELD_NAMES/Tracked::TRACKED_FIELD_NAMES from the macros; Storage::field_name and Storage::read_name (storage.rs); tests in db/tests.rs and blaze-query-macros/tests/structs.rs. The two hir-ty callers are 01323.
